===================================================================
--- /Users/baokker/Documents/SimpleRCPv2/.experiment-data/x2-eyZZup/log-parser-explicit-F-owner-r1/data/workspaces/demo/parse.py
+++ /Users/baokker/Documents/SimpleRCPv2/.experiment-data/x2-eyZZup/log-parser-explicit-F-owner-r1/data/workspaces/demo/parse.py
@@ -1,1 +1,26 @@
-print('TODO')
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+LOG_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "app.log"
+OUT_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "report.json"
+
+LEVELS = ["INFO", "WARN", "ERROR"]
+
+
+def parse(path: Path) -> dict:
+    counts = Counter()
+    with path.open() as f:
+        for line in f:
+            line = line.strip()
+            for level in LEVELS:
+                if line.startswith(level):
+                    counts[level] += 1
+                    break
+    return {level: counts.get(level, 0) for level in LEVELS}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    report = parse(LOG_PATH)
+    OUT_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(report))
+    print(report)
